title: Mod research tracks
description: Content/research_tracks.json: free-form research tracks beside the Knowledge Network. A node has a cost in research points, prerequisites, doctrine effect lanes and AI weights; researching it opens the gate 'tech:<node id>' that buildings, units and law options can require (prerequisites.tech), and raises the on_tech_researched hook. Mod nodes use their own research slots, fed with a share of the country's monthly research points on top of (not instead of) the Knowledge Network.

slots.description: Mod research slots that run at once (default 2).

points_share.description: Fraction of a country's monthly research points each mod slot receives (default 0.5). Nothing is taken from doctrine research.

starting.description: Nodes already researched at the start of a new game, by ISO3.

id.description: Unique across every mod node and doctrine card; content gates on 'tech:<id>'.

months.description: Minimum months to research, however many points a country has.

prerequisites.description: All of these must be researched first: node ids, 'tech:<id>' keys or doctrine gate keys such as 'military_t3'.

any_of.description: At least one of these must be researched, on top of prerequisites.

effects.description: Doctrine effect lanes, same keys as a doctrine card.

ai_weight.description: Extra AI preference added to the node's score.
